summary: A hand-made 820px column on wheat-coloured paper, themed on wholegrain bread (bread and butter type, bakery icons drawn in an icon font). Its core is a long OpenType feature catalogue of grey cards where red shows the feature's result, followed by a pay-what-you-want appeal, an FAQ and a comment form: a personal, long-lived free-font home page from 2006 onwards.

instances.look: A centred broadside in one narrow column: dark-red wheat icon tile, 'Vollkorn' in Black, ruled italic tagline, row of tan bakery icons, small-caps news line, 'free as always' in red, scripts line, 'pay what you want' in grey italic, oldstyle numerals, designer credit
instances.feel: Warm, homemade, like a bakery sign or a label on a flour sack
instances.ux: Most lines are links down the page (icons to In Use, 'free as always' to Download, 'pay what you want' to Donate), so the poster also acts as the menu. It's taller than the viewport at 1212px
instances.learn: Stack every feature of the family (Black, italic, small caps, oldstyle figures, Cyrillic and Greek) into one centred poster, each line delivering a fact: the hero becomes specimen, news and table of contents

reconstruction.layout: Centred 820px column at x=310 on a full-bleed wheat ground; stack: 270px rounded icon tile (32px radius) at y≈80, name, tagline between two 2px black rules 780px wide, 5 icons ~70px tall, then 5 centred lines, each filling most of the column at its own size

instances.look: A long stack of grey cards, one per OpenType feature: Small Caps, Localization, Figures, Combining Accents, Ligatures, Contextual Alternates, Superscripts, Titling, Historical Forms, Alternative Glyph Forms, Ordinals, Case Sensitive Forms, each showing default in black and the feature's result in red, often with '→'

instances.variantDefinition: An open comment form at the end of the page where visitors post thanks, bug reports and feature requests in public, often with a tally of the most requested features; visitors' voices rather than curated quotes
instances.look: 'Thanks, Bugs, Feature Requests' with a 'Discuss here or on Github' line, a 'Most wanted features ▼' pill, the empty-state line 'Be the first person to leave a comment' and a plain form (name, email, comment, Submit) powered by EasyComment
instances.ux: The pill reveals a tally of requests with counts (Polytonic Greek [12], Phonetic Alphabet IPA [5] / UPA [1], Pinyin [4]…). The captured page shows no comments
instances.learn: A public 'most wanted features' tally with counts shows visitors the type family is still being worked on, and tells the designer what to draw next
